crossRefs.note: “If anyone commits a trespass, and sins unwittingly regarding Yahweh’s holy things, then he shall bring his trespass…
He shall make restitution for that which he has done wrong regarding the holy thing, and shall add a fifth part to it…
He shall bring his trespass offering to Yahweh: a ram without defect from the flock, according to your estimation, for…
For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,
who gave himself as a ransom for all, the testimony in its own times,
He shall make restitution for that which he has done wrong regarding the holy thing, and shall add a fifth part to it…
He shall lay his hand on the head of the burnt offering, and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.
Thus shall he do with the bull; as he did with the bull of the sin offering, so shall he do with this; and the priest…
The priest shall make atonement for him before Yahweh, and he will be forgiven concerning whatever he does to become…

translations.web: He shall bring a ram without defect from of the flock, according to your estimation, for a trespass offering, to the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning the thing in which he sinned and didn’t know it, and he will be forgiven.
translations.bsb: He is to bring to the priest an unblemished ram of proper value from the flock as a guilt offering. Then the priest will make atonement on his behalf for the wrong he has committed in ignorance, and he will be forgiven.
translations.kjv: And he shall bring a ram without blemish out of the flock, with thy estimation, for a trespass offering, unto the priest: and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his ignorance wherein he erred and wist it not, and it shall be forgiven
translations.asv: And he shall bring a ram without blemish out of the flock, according to thy estimation, for a trespass-offering, unto the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning the thing wherein he erred unwittingly and knew it not, and he shall be forgiven.
